context_notes_en: A musical play in Egyptian colloquial after Shakespeare's “A Midsummer Night's Dream”; produced by the General Authority for Cultural Palaces – Alexandria; translation and poetry in Egyptian colloquial: Abdel Rahim Youssef; audition and recruitment of young Alexandrian actors and artists; double cast (each role with two or 3 actors alternating daily); Ahmed set a large part of the text to music; it was not continued because of production circumstances (Ahmed's confirmation 2026-11-08); El Lycee Theatre – Alexandria (from the archive).
